name: Ultralight Maple Slats, Beige Felt
summary: Real maple veneer laminated directly onto 9 mm recycled beige acoustic felt, with no MDF or other rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet overrides photo estimates: seven 1.20 in slat faces on 1.69 in pitches with 0.49 in, 90-degree V-grooves cut 6.2 mm into 9 mm felt; these rounded widths total 11.83 in versus the listed 11.80 in panel. Muted ultralight maple veneer and beige felt colors follow main.jpg, with no MDF or rigid core; the tile covers seven pitches by 23.66 in.
